run_distilbert_coreml_validation: run the distilbert validation script to compare Core ML and PyTorch model predictions
validate_coreml_model_against_pytorch: validate a Core ML distilbert model against its PyTorch counterpart using SNR and PSNR metrics
compute_snr_psnr_for_model_outputs: compute SNR and PSNR between Core ML start/end scores and PyTorch model outputs
load_coreml_model_and_predict: load a Core ML model spec and run predictions on random input token IDs
compare_start_end_scores: compare start and end scores from Core ML and PyTorch distilbert SQuAD models
